nodes.label: T7 build order (Zeno: T7c, then T7a, then T7b)
nodes.rationale: Smallest build first with the cheapest gate: T7c is one kernel swap gated by c->infinity, then T7a extends hfs_sic to per-orbital channels, then T7b the Fock builder with a two-value gate from Fischer 1977. Each closes before the next opens, and the 3d/5d species are the must-not-break controls.
